capabilities: Ingest notes into a topic-and-subtopic knowledge base via a guided LLM workflow
Review and edit LLM-drafted entries against line diffs before saving
Browse and search topics and subtopics in a dedicated view
Chat with an agent that answers questions about the open PDF with clickable page citations
Configure any OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint with a connection test
extras: The community listing states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents that note contents and PDF text are sent to the configured LLM endpoint and that the API key is stored locally in data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to consolidate notes into a curated topic hierarchy or to ask questions of a PDF with citations.

relations.evidence: works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: base URL, API key, model, reasoning effort

summary: LLM-powered knowledge base builder that classifies notes into topics and subtopics, plus a chat agent that answers questions about PDFs.
